title: Warning: SCAM ALERT!
body:
I recently fell victim to a blatant scam by Habio. Their app is designed to deceive users into making in-app purchases through misleading visuals and fine print. They tricked me into buying a PDF file for 29.99 euros, making it appear as though the product was free. The payment terms were deliberately hidden in a pale layout, ensuring most customers wouldn't notice until it was too late.

This is nothing short of FRAUD. The response from the merchant was dismissive, claiming that I had consented to the purchase. This is a lie. I did not consent to being scammed.

I will not let this slide. As a digital content creator, I am using every platform at my disposal to expose their deceitful practices. I will post reviews on the App Store, Play Store, Facebook, Trustpilot, and every other major review site to warn others.

Furthermore, their actions may be in direct violation of European consumer protection laws, particularly those related to transparent pricing and fair trading. I am prepared to report their practices to the relevant authorities and pursue legal action.

Do not fall for this scam. Avoid Habio at all costs and spread the word about their fraudulent behavior.

P.S: They will now respond to my review with a comment asking me to contact them by email, I did, and they will pretend to be professional and all, don't fall for that.
